message.content: {"note_claim": "Ecevit was informed early on the morning of the earthquake, visited the region by helicopter the same day, and gave a statement to TRT, so the claim he went to Yalova 2-3 days later is false.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Başbakan Ecevit beraberindeki heyetle birlikte depremin meydana geldiği 17 Ağustos 1999 günü afet bölgesine gitti.", "reason": "The page directly states Ecevit was woken at 5:00, went to the quake region the same day, and addressed TRT, substantiating the note's core claims."}

parsed.note_claim: Ecevit was informed early on the morning of the earthquake, visited the region by helicopter the same day, and gave a statement to TRT, so the claim he went to Yalova 2-3 days later is false.
